name: – Ingeborg Ter Laak – After recital 4 – Am 23
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council suspending the application of the rules on the appointment of authorised representatives for extended producer responsibility for waste, waste electrical and electronical equipment and single use plastic waste
part_text: (4a) The suspension of the administrative requirement concerning the appointment of an authorised representative introduced by this Directive should also be aimed at suspending the obligations of producers with regard to extended producer responsibility in their entirety until the issues relating to administrative burdens have been resolved.
